capability: Check what must stay true on every wiki edit
title: Change everything but the pins.

hook.picture: Close on the whale (z 1.6) following a thin link from one dot. The link ends in a frayed curl in empty air, and the whale bumps into nothing.
hook.words: I followed the link. It went nowhere.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I followed the wiki's link, and it went nowhere.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Ghost lines of past saves stack behind the line. Each saved edit moves a dot and snaps a different link: every 2 beats, then 1, then half.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Edits get saved. No one checks the rest.

stakes.body: New people and AI helpers read the wiki as true. One broken link sends both to a dead page, and the wrong answer travels.

solution_hint: Name what must stay true. Check every edit.

metaphor.body: The wiki is a line with dots joined by threads. Three pins hold what must stay true, so the line can bend freely and the threads still land.

steps.picture: The whale taps three hollow dots left to right. Each slides home, a pin drops in, and the loose links land on it again. Icons: source, link, page.
steps.sound: Knock and tuned mallet per pin: A2, E3, A3.

steps.picture: Each pin carries its law in plain words: Every claim sourced · No broken links · One page per thing.
Free edits: the whale lands three times and bends the line hard. It still runs through all three pins; a ring checks each edit and a tick is written.
steps.words: Edit freely. These three laws never move.
steps.sound: The same A plucked, varied brightness.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.32). A heavy landing drags the link pin; two links come loose; the save gate drops a copper bar. The whale lifts, the pin snaps home, the gate opens.
steps.words: Breaks a link? Stopped and fixed before saving.
steps.sound: String pulled flat and beating, then snaps into tune.

steps.picture: One more edit passes; the copper tick for the stopped edit is ringed on the record.

real_case.claim: Merging the 437-entity p5.js atlas with the new lab entities gave 548 entities and 2,933 triples with exact violations 0 and provenance coverage 0.988.

honest_limit.picture: The source pin's icon opens into a grid of 60 ticks: 47 deep green, 13 copper. The atlas citation audit fails 13, but the pins never noticed.
honest_limit.words: A source can still say something else.

not_this.body: Checked means no known breaks. Not proven true.

ending_pattern.body: The whale follows the same link from the same dot and lands on the pinned dot. The pod that answered with a cross now answers with a tick, then the line is shaken and every link holds; the three laws return under their pins.
ending_pattern.callback: The link that ended in empty air in bar 1 now lands on a pin, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Pick three things your wiki must keep.

beats.picture: Close on the whale swimming along a thin link from one dot. The link ends in a frayed curl in empty air; its dot has moved away below.
beats.sound: Room tone.

beats.words: I followed the link. It went nowhere.
beats.sound: Detuned wooden pluck that sags, no ring.

beats.sound: Flatter pluck, softer.

beats.picture: An AI pod follows the same link to the same dead end and answers with a copper cross chip.
beats.words: The AI followed it too. Wrong answer.
beats.sound: Dull thunk.

beats.picture: The pod swims off with its wrong answer. The whale watches (focus face).
beats.sound: Low whoosh, then near-silence.

beats.sound: Airy whoosh.

beats.words: Edits get saved. No one checks the rest.
beats.sound: The problem pluck three times, faster, each with a snap.

beats.picture: Four links hang loose and flutter over the bent line.
beats.sound: Silence under the flutter.

beats.picture: All motion stops. Three dashed rings glow where the dots belong.
beats.words: Name what must stay true. Check every edit.
beats.sound: One clean, in-tune A: the first signature.

beats.sound: Room under the pulse.

beats.picture: Free edits: the whale lands three times and bends the line hard. It still runs through all three pins; a ring checks each edit and a tick is written.

beats.sound: The same A plucked, varied brightness.

beats.picture: One more edit passes; the copper tick for the stopped edit is ringed on the record.

beats.picture: A second line (the lab) slides in from the right and docks; the pins hold, its new links land, ticks stream on the record.
beats.words: Real run: two wikis merged into one.
beats.sound: Pulse bed, docking knock, the A in tune.

beats.picture: Card on clean paper: Real run · Memory graph map / 548 entities · 2,933 links · 0 laws broken · 0.988 sourced.
beats.sound: Two soft notes.

beats.picture: The whale checks each new dot; each one's source tick pulses and the record ticks.
beats.words: Nearly every new fact named its source.
beats.sound: High mallet per dot, quiet ticks.

beats.camera: still, then one slow push to the source pin
beats.picture: Still, then a slow push into the source pin. Its source icon opens into a grid of 60 ticks: 47 deep green, 13 copper.
beats.words: A source can still say something else.
beats.sound: The signature A once, against a B-flat; unresolved.

beats.picture: Card text: Atlas citation audit · 47 of 60 faithful. A check ring passes the pin; it stays calm. The pins never noticed.
beats.sound: Dry ticks; a calm ping.

beats.camera: still, then pan back to the FELT framing
beats.picture: The grid folds away.
beats.words: Checked means no known breaks. Not proven true.
beats.sound: Room tone.

beats.picture: Same framing as bar 1. The whale follows the same link from the same dot; this time it lands on the pinned dot and glows.
beats.sound: Pluck, then a true A rings.

beats.picture: The pod from bar 3 follows the link and answers with a deep-green tick. The whale spouts: delight, spark.
beats.sound: A major arpeggio: resolution.

beats.picture: The pod leaves with the right answer; the line is shaken hard, all pins and links hold, then still.
beats.sound: The one A strummed on every 8th.

beats.picture: Still line, three pins, every link landed, the whale breathing beside the link pin.
beats.words: Pick three things your wiki must keep.
beats.sound: Pad tail on the open A chord.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup over the settled line.
beats.sound: One low A.
